name: Maria Lopez
learned: Maria Lopez is a student at Oak Hill College studying physics and a part time Twitch game streamer who loves to connect with people and explore new ideas.
currently: Maria wakes up at 9:00 am on Wednesday February 15 to start her morning routine. She plans to head over to Hobbs Cafe around 10:30 am for continued community involvement and support of ongoing activities there. At noon, she intends to have a light meal either back at the cafe or grab something quick while out. In the afternoon, Maria will continue discussions with Klaus Mueller on his research about gentrification impacts, meeting around 1:30 pm to analyze data from recent interviews and prepare a summary report. From 3:00 pm until 6:00 pm, she will be Twitch streaming games as part of her regular schedule, which also helps keep her connected with the community online. For dinner, Maria has plans for a get-together at Hobbs Cafe starting around 6:00 pm with colleagues and friends to unwind after a busy day. Later in the evening, once decorations from Valentine's Day have been taken down following the event, she will assist in packing them up before settling in for some downtime starting from 9:00 pm. She feels enthusiastic and fulfilled by her full engagement in both academic pursuits and community involvement this week, finding unique opportunities to contribute meaningfully while fostering connections and making a positive impact wherever possible.
